titulo_es: A shared solution · Two brief opinions

texto: An opinion can be recognized by «jeg synes» or «efter min mening». He looks for the reason that accompanies her and checks whether the second text agrees, nuances or disagrees.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
